retriever.tie_break: passage_id ascending; reranker ties first use RRF descending

structured_inputs.ranking_depth_rule: shortest prefix with >=5 chunks and maximum budget words, or all available
structured_inputs.truncation_rule: ranked prefix; last chunk ends at the final retained word; no skipping
structured_inputs.word_count_rule: Unicode non-whitespace runs: \S+; body only; overlap counted repeatedly

timing_policy: perf_counter wall seconds; index_seconds includes factory construction, model initialization and passage encoding; per-query includes full retrieval and lazy first BGE scoring load; no hidden warm-up; excludes report rendering
